Technical Product Owner | Agile Delivery | Product Strategy | SaaS Platforms | AI-Driven Products | Former Team Lead

CONTACT DETAILS

ankitguptamca1@gmail.com

+91 9871622633

Delhi - 110007

EDUCATION

MCA, Gitarattan Business School, Delhi, 2013

International

BCA, Mother Teresa Institute of Management, 2010

CORE COMPETENCIES

Product Strategy & Ownership Agile Methodology & Scrum Framework Requirements & Backlog Management Digital Transformation & Automation API Integration & Microservices Agile Scaling & Delivery Governance US Healthcare Systems Scalable Software Solutions Data-driven Decision Making Customer Experience & UX Focus Stakeholder Management & Leadership Client Communication & Cross- Functional Collaboration Market & Competitor Analysis Recruitment Initiatives

JOB OBJECTIVE

Dynamic and results-oriented CSPO® and IBM AI certified Product Owner with a strong focus on delivering innovative solutions in the software development industry. Expertise in managing product lifecycles, driving digital transformation, and enhancing customer experiences across diverse domains.

PROFILE SUMMARY

Seasoned & accomplished Leader with 12+ years of progressive experience in product ownership, enterprise SaaS delivery, and Agile-driven digital transformation across Hospitality, US Healthcare, E-Commerce, Real Estate, News, and E-Learning ecosystems. Strong technical foundation as a former Developer and Team Lead, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams, architects, and DevOps. IBM Generative AI and CSPO-certified professional wit proven track record in defining product vision, shaping roadmap strategy, and leading end-to-end product lifecycle management, translating complex business needs into scalable, API-driven, and cloud-enabled product solutions. Strong expertise in Agile frameworks (Scrum & Kanban), backlog governance, sprint execution, and cross-functional delivery, ensuring high-impact feature releases aligned with business KPIs and customer outcomes. Facilitated discovery workshops and requirements sessions with business stakeholders and enterprise clients to define product vision, roadmap priorities, and solution requirements. Showcased success in building and scaling enterprise-grade platforms with focus on system integration, workflow automation, and data-driven product optimization to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. Hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered capabilities including Generative AI, conversational assistants, and intelligent analytics solutions using tools such as ChatGPT, AWS Kiro, and DeepSeek to accelerate product innovation and decision intelligence. Skilled at stakeholder engagement and strategic alignment across global teams, with strong capabilities in business analysis, competitive market evaluation, risk mitigation, and delivering measurable value in fast-paced, enterprise environments.

WORK EXPERIENCE

UNIFOCUS, Gurugram | Technical Product Owner | Oct 2022 - Present

Key Result Areas:

Spearheading end-to-end product strategy, roadmap planning, and Agile delivery for enterprise SaaS platforms, collaborating with business, engineering, QA, architecture, and operations teams to deliver scalable, business-aligned digital solutions. lifecycle from discovery to post-launch Owning the complete product optimization, including problem framing, solution design, requirement analysis, backlog prioritization, release planning, and continuous improvement. Translating business objectives and customer needs into well-defined epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs to maximize delivery efficiency and business impact. Driving stakeholder alignment across product leadership, engineering, DevOps, and business teams to ensure execution readiness, seamless collaboration, and successful product adoption. Leading product discovery, customer journey analysis, and workflow design initiatives to identify high-value opportunities and define scalable, validated solution approaches. Partnering with engineering and architecture teams on API integrations, system interoperability, and cloud-based SaaS design, ensuring technical feasibility and robust solution delivery.

IT SKILLS

Agile Product Delivery: Agile (Scrum & Kanban), Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, SAFe

AI & Generative AI Product Management: Prompt Engineering, AI Awareness, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, AWS Kiro

Governance

Technical & System Design Tools: Swagger (API Documentation), SQL, Cloud-based Platforms, SaaS Draw.io (Process & Architecture Modelling)

UX & Product Design: Figma, Balsamiq, Wireframing, Prototype Design

Domain Expertise: US Healthcare Domain, Hospitality, E-Commerce, Real Estate, News, and E-Learning Platform ecosystems, Solutions ,& Analytics Platforms

Digital

Release Management & CI/CD Collaboration

CERTIFICATIONS

CSPO® - Certified Scrum Product Owner

Generative AI Certification

Facilitating and governing Agile execution using Scrum and Kanban, while managing sprint ceremonies, release planning, UAT coordination, defect triage, and KPI-driven performance tracking to ensure delivery quality and operational stability. Created and maintained PRDs, functional specifications, workflow diagrams, process documentation, and release notes to support product delivery and stakeholder communication. Collaborate with DevOps teams and leverage Azure DevOps for backlog governance, sprint execution, work-item tracking, dependency management, release planning, defect triage and delivery visibility. Use Azure DevOps delivery dashboards and Agile metrics to track sprint progress, blockers, dependencies, release readiness and delivery performance across distributed teams. Lead the definition and delivery of AI-powered product capabilities, translating business problems into AI use cases, product requirements, workflows and measurable success criteria. Partner with AI, engineering and architecture teams to evaluate AI solution approaches and integrate Generative AI, conversational AI, intelligent analytics and automation into enterprise product workflows. Define AI product requirements covering AI-assisted decision support, conversational workflows, intelligent summarization and workflow automation, balancing user needs, business outcomes and technical feasibility. Define product including conversational experiences, natural-language interfaces, AI summarization and intelligent information retrieval. Partner with AI engineering teams to define and validate RAG-based product workflows, translating business requirements into retrieval, response-generation and user-interaction requirements. Collaborate with engineering, architecture and DevOps teams on Microsoft Azure-based product delivery, ensuring product requirements are aligned with cloud architecture, technical feasibility and enterprise delivery standards. Leverage Azure DevOps for product backlog management, epic/feature decomposition, sprint planning, work-item tracking, dependency management, defect management, release coordination and delivery governance. Manage AI lifecycle, covering AI use-case identification, discovery, requirements, data/workflow considerations, solution design, development, testing, UAT, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement. Drive adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities to improve workflow automation, decision support, knowledge access, summarization and operational efficiency across enterprise products.

Led development of API-driven enterprise SaaS platforms focused on system integration, workflow automation, and cross-platform interoperability. Enabled seamless enterprise connectivity by defining integration requirements and supporting automation-driven digital transformation initiatives.

Defined business outcomes, success metrics, and AI workflows to improve decision-making efficiency and enhance customer experience intelligence.

Conversational AI Guest Insights Assistant (AI Chatbot)

Contributed to product strategy and solution design for a conversational AI assistant enabling natural language access to guest insights. Defined conversational workflows and user journeys to support self-service analytics and faster hospitality decision-making.

Platform Product Ownership (Shared Enterprise Services)

Owned platform services including user administration, reporting, task scheduling, notifications, and security modules across enterprise applications. Managed backlog prioritization, stakeholder alignment, sprint execution, and Agile delivery for scalable platform capabilities.

Key Highlights:

Contributed to high-impact enterprise hospitality programs for global clients, including Hilton-integrated workflows, supporting platform usage across 50,000+ end users in international hotel environments. Enhanced sprint delivery predictability by 15% by enforcing structured backlog prioritization, release discipline, and tighter stakeholder alignment. Managed product backlog of 2000+ user stories, achieving 85% sprint predictability across distributed Agile teams. Delivered enterprise-grade product enhancements across North America, Europe, MENA, Australia, and Asia, maintaining consistent release quality and platform stability. Optimized delivery governance practices, reducing requirement ambiguity and improving on-time sprint completion rates by approximately 12%.

Nmg Technologies, Gurugram | May 2017 - Sep 2022 Growth Path: Tech Lead | May 2017 - Jul 2018 Business Analyst | Aug 2018 - Sep 2022

Key Result Areas: Business Analyst

Led product discovery and requirement workshops with clients across the US, Europe, and Australia to define scalable digital product solutions aligned with business goals. Managed end-to-end product backlog and Agile delivery cycles, ensuring alignment between engineering execution, roadmap priorities, and stakeholder expectations. Designed functional specifications, user stories, wireframes, API contracts, and data workflows for integrated web and mobile SaaS ecosystems. Directed UAT and release validation activities, improving client satisfaction scores by 20% through enhanced release quality and defect reduction. Analyzed post-release performance metrics to identify gaps and drive data- backed product enhancements and continuous improvement. Led product ownership for a US-based healthcare platform enabling patient- provider connectivity, covering onboarding, scheduling, booking, and care delivery workflows. Contributed to Wolomi maternal US health platform by defining user journeys, engagement workflows, and digital support experiences for expecting mothers through community-driven healthcare solutions.

Led engineering delivery for on-demand food ordering and e-commerce platforms, managing complex backend/API integrations for scalable enterprise applications. Collaborated with backend engineering production issue resolution, and seamless delivery of high-impact features.
